verdict.rationale: Stripe's own docs say it can register on your behalf, and that registrations are managed in the Dashboard Locations tab or through the Tax Registrations API. That establishes an in-product, vendor-handled registration capability, but it rests on a single thin mention. Missing for 10: transparent per-registration pricing, status tracking for vendor-filed registrations, explicit coverage of both state and local registrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, registering for a sales tax permit is handled in-product — the vendor files state and local registrations on my behalf with transparent per-registration pricing and status tracking

citations.quote: You can also use Stripe to register on your behalf.
add your registrations to Stripe using the Locations tab in the Dashboard or Tax Registrations API
Register to collect tax as soon as you start processing payments.
